partial_graph_overlap.root_cause: In the original implementation, DetectionEngine only flagged an event for lateral movement if (src, tgt) was completely absent from ServiceGraph. However, attackers probing a multi-hop path may traverse an edge that exists in the graph topology (e.g., node 9 to node 10), but their request is denied due to lack of authorization. The original engine treated these hops as isolated denials because len(unexpected_edges) < 2.
partial_graph_overlap.resolution: DetectionEngine was updated to cluster all unauthorized service transitions AND all denied probes within the same actor session/flow. If an actor conducts >= 2 denied probes or unexpected service hops in a session, all events in the chain are correctly classified as lateral_movement_candidate.
